beats.title: Qualifiers: Three Rounds of Magical Tests
beats.summary: The Qualifiers consist of three rounds: hitting a floating target with a spell, holding a special ice crystal to summon and withstand an Ice Elemental while maintaining Concentration, and deciphering the magic pattern within a special stone.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-1:f1045adefbd6:span:f1045adefbd6:17-17
anchor_quotes: The Qualifiers consist of three rounds and test whether they have what it takes to duel.
The test is to hit a floating target with a spell.
The second test is to hold a special ice crystal and summon an Ice Elemental.
And the final test is, when given a special stone, can they decipher the magic pattern within.

beats.title: Ephanna Excels in the Qualifiers
beats.summary: Ephanna, a Warlock, chooses Eldritch Blast, handles the Ice Elemental test, and easily solves the stone test by recognizing it as a Fey toy. Her performance excites the note-taking wizards.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-1:f1045adefbd6:span:f1045adefbd6:17-17
anchor_quotes: First up: Ephanna. As a Warlock the spell choice was obvious: Eldritch Blast.
The mystical stone, when held, turned out to be a Fey toy, something that Ephanna was very familiar with and took no time at all to solve.
The other wizards taking notes during the qualifiers became very excited at this new participant.

beats.title: Caelynn Passes Qualifiers Despite Difficult Final Test
beats.summary: Nervous Caelynn picks Magic Missile, passes the second test, and after a long struggle deciphers the pattern on the stone, succeeding in the end.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-1:f1045adefbd6:span:f1045adefbd6:17-17
